# Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
# Synced via: task backup:sync
# Docs: https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Backup_and_Restore
#
# Backup Tiers:
#   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (openwebui, immich, n8n)
#   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, portainer, etc.)
#
# To add a new container:
#   1. Add the container ID to the appropriate job below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync
#   3. (Optional) Add pre-backup hook in pre-backup-hook.sh if database dump needed

# =============================================================================
# Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
# =============================================================================
# 304 = immich (photos database)
# 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
# 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
vzdump: daily-user-data
	enabled 1
	schedule 02:00
	storage backup-tank
	mailnotification failure
	mode snapshot
	compress zstd
	vmid 304,501,502
	script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
	prune-backups keep-daily=7

# =============================================================================
# Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
# =============================================================================
# 100 = portainer
# 101 = network-services (adguard)
# 200 = traefik
# 201 = dashboards
# 202 = authelia
# 401 = jellyfin
# 402 = media-management
# 500 = monitoring
vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
	enabled 1
	schedule sun 03:00
	storage backup-tank
	mailnotification failure
	mode snapshot
	compress zstd
	vmid 100,101,200,201,202,401,402,500
	script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
	prune-backups keep-weekly=4

# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
# =============================================================================
# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    pbs_datastore: homelab

    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    daily_containers:
      - 304  # immich
      - 303  # immich-importer
      - 501  # openwebui
      - 502  # n8n
      - 503  # obsidian-sync
      - 504  # documents

    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
    weekly_containers:
      - 100  # portainer
      - 101  # network-services
      - 200  # traefik
      - 201  # dashboards-app
      - 202  # authelia
      - 401  # jellyfin
      - 402  # media-management
      - 500  # monitoring-app

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS Storage
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS storage status
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
      register: pbs_status
      changed_when: false
      tags: [always]

    - name: Verify PBS is active
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
          Fix by updating PBS password:
            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
      tags: [always]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
      register: hook_script
      tags: [always]

    - name: Display hook script status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
      tags: [verify]

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure Backup Jobs
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        content: |
          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
          #
          # Backup Strategy:
          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, portainer, etc.)
          #
          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

          # =============================================================================
          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
          # =============================================================================
          # 304 = immich (photos database)
          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
          vzdump: daily-user-data
          	enabled 1
          	schedule 02:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7

          # =============================================================================
          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
          # =============================================================================
          # 100 = portainer
          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
          # 200 = traefik
          # 201 = dashboards-app
          # 202 = authelia
          # 401 = jellyfin
          # 402 = media-management
          # 500 = monitoring-app
          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
          	enabled 1
          	schedule sun 03:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
        mode: '0640'
      register: jobs_config
      tags: [configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: List configured backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
      register: backup_jobs
      changed_when: false
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Count daily backup containers
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
          - ""
          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 7 days"
          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Excluded from backups:"
          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
      register: trigger_result
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

    - name: Display trigger result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

1→# Homelab Backup Strategy
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.
     6→
     7→## Backup Tiers
     8→
     9→### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)
    10→
    11→User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.
    12→
    13→| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
    14→|----|---------|-----------------|
    15→| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
    16→| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
    17→| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |
    18→
    19→### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)
    20→
    21→Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.
    22→
    23→| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
    24→|----|---------|-----------------|
    25→| 100 | Portainer | None |
    26→| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
    27→| 200 | Traefik | None |
    28→| 201 | Dashboards | None |
    29→| 202 | Authelia | None |
    30→| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
    31→| 402 | Media Management | None |
    32→| 500 | Monitoring | None |
    33→
    34→### Excluded Containers
    35→
    36→- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
    37→- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container
    38→
    39→## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
    40→
    41→All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.
    42→
    43→| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
    44→|------|----------|--------|-------------|
    45→| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
    46→| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
    47→| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |
    48→
    49→### Daily Timeline
    50→
    51→```text
    52→2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
    53→3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
    54→4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
    55→```
    56→
    57→## Storage Layout
    58→
    59→```text
    60→/tank/backups/
    61→├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
    62→│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
    63→│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
    64→│   └── ...
    65→└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    66→    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    67→    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    68→    ├── openwebui-*.db
    69→    └── n8n-*.db
    70→```
    71→
    72→## Taskfile Commands
    73→
    74→### Local Backups
    75→
    76→```bash
    77→# Sync backup config to Proxmox
    78→task backup:sync
    79→
    80→# View status
    81→task backup:status
    82→
    83→# Manual backups
    84→task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
    85→task backup:all                   # All containers
    86→
    87→# List backups for an app
    88→task backup:list APP=immich
    89→
    90→# Restore container
    91→task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305
    92→
    93→# Immich database operations
    94→task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
    95→task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
    96→```
    97→
    98→### Cloud Backups
    99→
   100→```bash
   101→# Trigger cloud sync
   102→task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
   103→task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
   104→task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only
   105→
   106→# Check status
   107→task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
   108→task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
   109→task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
   110→task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync
   111→
   112→# View logs
   113→task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
   114→task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
   115→```
   116→
   117→## Restore Procedures
   118→
   119→### Full Container Restore
   120→
   121→```bash
   122→# 1. List available backups
   123→task backup:list APP=openwebui
   124→
   125→# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
   126→task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505
   127→
   128→# 3. Verify restored container
   129→ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"
   130→
   131→# 4. If verified, swap with original:
   132→#    - Stop original (501)
   133→#    - Update network config on new container
   134→#    - Start new container
   135→```
   136→
   137→### Database-Only Restore
   138→
   139→```bash
   140→# Immich PostgreSQL
   141→task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
   142→
   143→# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   144→ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
   145→```
   146→
   147→### Extract Files from Backup
   148→
   149→```bash
   150→ssh root@homelab
   151→cd /tmp
   152→tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
   153→# Navigate and extract needed files
   154→```
   155→
   156→## Monitoring
   157→
   158→### Check Backup Status
   159→
   160→```bash
   161→# View scheduled jobs
   162→ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"
   163→
   164→# View hook script logs
   165→ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
   166→
   167→# Check local storage usage
   168→task backup:status
   169→
   170→# Check cloud backup status
   171→task cloud:status
   172→```
   173→
   174→### Proxmox UI
   175→
   176→Backup jobs visible at: **Datacenter > Backup**
   177→
   178→## Files Reference
   179→
   180→| File | Location | Purpose |
   181→|------|----------|---------|
   182→| Job config (source) | `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg` | Scheduled vzdump job definitions |
   183→| Hook script (source) | `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Pre-backup database dumps |
   184→| Job config (deployed) | `/etc/pve/jobs.cfg` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
   185→| Hook script (deployed) | `/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
   186→| Hook log | `/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log` | Hook script output |
   187→| Cloud sync script | `/root/cloud-sync.sh` | Vzdump to B2 sync (on Proxmox) |
   188→| Photos sync script | `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh` | Photos to B2 sync (on LXC 303) |
   189→
   190→## Adding New Containers
   191→
   192→1. Edit `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg`:
   193→   - Add container ID to `daily-user-data` (for user data) or `weekly-infrastructure` (for infra)
   194→2. Edit `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh` and `scripts/backup/backup-list.sh`:
   195→   - Add the app name to container ID mapping
   196→3. (Optional) If container has a database, edit `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh`:
   197→   - Add a dump function and case in `backup-start`
   198→4. Run `task backup:sync` to deploy configs to Proxmox
   199→
   200→## Database Notes
   201→
   202→### Immich (304)
   203→
   204→- PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs extension (ML embeddings)
   205→- Container: `immich_postgres`
   206→- Dumps kept 7 days
   207→
   208→### Jellystat (401)
   209→
   210→- PostgreSQL 15 for Jellyfin statistics

# Homelab Backup Strategy

## Overview

Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.

## Backup Tiers

### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)

User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |

### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)

Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 100 | Portainer | None |
| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
| 200 | Traefik | None |
| 201 | Dashboards | None |
| 202 | Authelia | None |
| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
| 402 | Media Management | None |
| 500 | Monitoring | None |

### Excluded Containers

- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container

## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)

All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.

| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |

### Daily Timeline

```text
2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
```

## Storage Layout

```text
/tank/backups/
├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
│   └── ...
└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── openwebui-*.db
    └── n8n-*.db
```

## Taskfile Commands

### Local Backups

```bash
# Sync backup config to Proxmox
task backup:sync

# View status
task backup:status

# Manual backups
task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
task backup:all                   # All containers

# List backups for an app
task backup:list APP=immich

# Restore container
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305

# Immich database operations
task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

### Cloud Backups

```bash
# Trigger cloud sync
task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only

# Check status
task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync

# View logs
task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
```

## Restore Procedures

### Full Container Restore

```bash
# 1. List available backups
task backup:list APP=openwebui

# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505

# 3. Verify restored container
ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"

# 4. If verified, swap with original:
#    - Stop original (501)
#    - Update network config on new container
#    - Start new container
```

### Database-Only Restore

```bash
# Immich PostgreSQL
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz

# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
```

### Extract Files from Backup

```bash
ssh root@homelab
cd /tmp
tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
# Navigate and extract needed files
```

## Monitoring

### Check Backup Status

```bash
# View scheduled jobs
ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"

# View hook script logs
ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"

# Check local storage usage
task backup:status

# Check cloud backup status
task cloud:status
```

### Proxmox UI

Backup jobs visible at: **Datacenter > Backup**

## Files Reference

| File | Location | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| Job config (source) | `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg` | Scheduled vzdump job definitions |
| Hook script (source) | `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Pre-backup database dumps |
| Job config (deployed) | `/etc/pve/jobs.cfg` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook script (deployed) | `/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook log | `/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log` | Hook script output |
| Cloud sync script | `/root/cloud-sync.sh` | Vzdump to B2 sync (on Proxmox) |
| Photos sync script | `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh` | Photos to B2 sync (on LXC 303) |

## Adding New Containers

1. Edit `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg`:
   - Add container ID to `daily-user-data` (for user data) or `weekly-infrastructure` (for infra)
2. Edit `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh` and `scripts/backup/backup-list.sh`:
   - Add the app name to container ID mapping
3. (Optional) If container has a database, edit `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh`:
   - Add a dump function and case in `backup-start`
4. Run `task backup:sync` to deploy configs to Proxmox

## Database Notes

### Immich (304)

- PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs extension (ML embeddings)
- Container: `immich_postgres`
- Dumps kept 7 days

### Jellystat (401)

- PostgreSQL 15 for Jellyfin statistics
- Container: `jellystat-db`
- User/DB: `jellystat`
- Dumps kept 4 weeks

### OpenWebUI (501)

- SQLite at `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- Contains chat history, users, settings
- Copied directly (no sqlite3 in container)

### n8n (502)

- SQLite at `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- Contains workflows, credentials, execution history

# Ansible Automation for Homelab

Operational automation playbooks for backup, monitoring, and day-2 operations.

## 📁 Directory Structure

```
ansible/
├── ansible.cfg              # Ansible configuration
├── inventory/
│   └── hosts.yml           # Static inventory (all LXCs + Proxmox)
├── playbooks/              # Standalone playbooks
│   ├── backup-all.yml      # Backup all containers
│   ├── backup-lxc.yml      # Backup specific containers
│   └── backup-immich-db.yml # Backup Immich database
├── roles/                  # Reusable roles (future)
├── group_vars/            # Group-specific variables
└── host_vars/             # Host-specific variables
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

```bash
# Install ansible-navigator (already installed via uv)
uv tool install ansible-navigator

# Verify SSH access
ssh root@homelab
```

### Running Playbooks

All commands run from the `ansible/` directory:

```bash
cd ansible

# Backup all containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup specific containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304

# Backup Immich database
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml
```

## 📋 Available Playbooks

### Backup Operations

#### `backup-all.yml`
Backup all LXC containers using vzdump.

**Options:**
- `backup_storage`: Storage target (default: `backup-tank`)
- `backup_mode`: Backup mode (default: `snapshot`)
- `backup_compress`: Compression (default: `zstd`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard backup to backup-tank
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup to PBS
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml -e backup_storage=pbs

# Run only pre-backup hooks
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml --tags pre-backup
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-all.sh`

---

#### `backup-lxc.yml`
Backup specific containers by hostname or container ID.

**Required:**
- `target`: Comma-separated hostnames (e.g., `immich,jellyfin`)
- OR `container_id`: Single container ID

**Examples:**
```bash
# Backup by hostname
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich

# Backup multiple containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin,traefik

# Backup by container ID
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh`

---

#### `backup-immich-db.yml`
Create PostgreSQL database dump for Immich.

**Options:**
- `backup_dir`: Backup directory (default: `/photos/immich-backups`)
- `retention_days`: Days to keep old backups (default: `7`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard database backup
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml

# Custom backup location
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e backup_dir=/custom/path

# Longer retention
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e retention_days=30
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/immich-db.sh`

---

## 🎯 Inventory

The inventory is defined in [inventory/hosts.yml](inventory/hosts.yml) and mirrors the IP registry from OpenTofu ([tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf](../tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf)).

### Groups

- `proxmox`: Proxmox VE host
- `lxc`: All LXC containers
  - `core`: Portainer, network-services, PBS
  - `dashboards`: Traefik, Homepage, Authelia
  - `photos`: Immich, immich-importer
  - `media`: Jellyfin, media-management
  - `monitoring`: Monitoring, OpenWebUI, n8n, Obsidian, Documents
- `backup_containers`: Containers to include in backups
- `docker_containers`: Containers running Docker Compose

### Viewing Inventory

```bash
# List all hosts
ansible-inventory --list

# List specific group
ansible-inventory --graph backup_containers

# Show host details
ansible-inventory --host immich
```

## 🔧 Testing Connectivity

```bash
# Ping all hosts
ansible all -m ping

# Ping specific group
ansible backup_containers -m ping

# Run command on all LXCs
ansible lxc -a "uptime"
```

## 📝 Configuration

The [ansible.cfg](ansible.cfg) file configures:
- Inventory location
- SSH settings (uses `~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519`)
- Output formatting (YAML)
- Performance tuning (10 forks, fact caching)
- Logging (`/tmp/ansible.log`)

## 🆚 Comparison: Bash vs Ansible

### Before (Bash)
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

source "$SCRIPT_DIR/containers.sh"
ssh root@homelab "vzdump $ALL_BACKUP_CONTAINERS --storage backup-tank --mode snapshot --compress zstd"
```

**Issues:**
- No error handling
- Manual container list management
- No idempotency
- Limited logging

### After (Ansible)
```yaml
# playbooks/backup-all.yml

- name: Backup all LXC containers
  hosts: proxmox
  tasks:
    - name: Run vzdump backup
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: vzdump {{ container_ids | join(' ') }} ...
      register: backup_result
```

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Automatic inventory from hosts.yml
- ✅ Error handling built-in
- ✅ Idempotent operations
- ✅ Structured logging
- ✅ Dry-run support (`--check`)
- ✅ Tags for selective execution

---

### Temporary Infrastructure

#### `desktop-lxc.yml`
Create/destroy temporary desktop LXC for Google Takeout downloads.

**Tags:**
- `create`: Create desktop LXC with XFCE + VNC + Chrome
- `destroy`: Destroy desktop LXC

**Examples:**
```bash
# Create desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags create

# Destroy desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags destroy
```

**Features:**
- Ubuntu 24.04 LXC with XFCE desktop
- TigerVNC server on port 5901
- Google Chrome pre-installed
- NAS mount at /downloads → /tank/photo-import
- Random VNC password generated on creation

**Replaces:** `scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh`, `scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh`

---

### PBS Management

#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`

Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) backup jobs.

**Tags:**

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Proxmox Vzdump Pre-Backup Hook Script
# =============================================================================
# Called by vzdump before/after backing up each container.
# Performs database dumps for containers that need consistent backups.
#
# Arguments passed by vzdump:
#   $1 - phase (job-start, job-end, job-abort, backup-start, backup-end, backup-abort)
#   $2 - mode (stop, suspend, snapshot)
#   $3 - vmid (container/VM ID)
#
# To add a new container with pre-backup tasks:
#   1. Add a case in the backup-start section below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync:hook
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

PHASE="$1"
MODE="${2:-}"
VMID="${3:-}"

LOGFILE="/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') [$PHASE] VMID=$VMID: $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

# =============================================================================
# Database Backup Functions
# =============================================================================

# Immich PostgreSQL (Container ID: 304)
backup_immich_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Immich PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/immich-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    if pct exec 304 -- docker exec immich_postgres \
        pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# OpenWebUI SQLite (Container ID: 501)
backup_openwebui_sqlite() {
    log "Creating OpenWebUI SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/openwebui-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # The volume mount puts webui.db at /config/openwebui/webui.db on the LXC host
    if pct pull 501 /config/openwebui/webui.db "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "openwebui-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# n8n SQLite (Container ID: 502)
backup_n8n_sqlite() {
    log "Creating n8n SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/n8n-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # n8n stores its database at /config/n8n/database.sqlite
    if pct pull 502 /config/n8n/database.sqlite "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed (container may not exist yet)"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "n8n-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Jellyfin Jellystat PostgreSQL (Container ID: 401)
backup_jellystat_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Jellystat PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/jellystat-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    # Jellystat uses postgres:15-alpine with database "jellystat" and user "jellystat"
    if pct exec 401 -- docker exec jellystat-db \
        pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Jellystat database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 4 weeks for weekly backups)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +28 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Logic
# =============================================================================

case "$PHASE" in
    job-start)
        mkdir -p "$DB_DUMP_DIR"
        log "Backup job starting"
        ;;

    backup-start)
        log "Backup starting (mode: $MODE)"

        # Container-specific pre-backup tasks
        case "$VMID" in
            304)
                # Immich - dump PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_immich_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            401)
                # Jellyfin - dump Jellystat PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_jellystat_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            501)
                # OpenWebUI - backup SQLite database
                backup_openwebui_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            502)
                # n8n - backup SQLite database
                backup_n8n_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            *)
                # No pre-backup tasks for this container
                ;;
        esac
        ;;

    backup-end)
        log "Backup completed"
        ;;

    backup-abort)
        log "WARNING: Backup aborted"
        ;;

    job-end)
        log "Backup job completed"
        ;;

    job-abort)
        log "ERROR: Backup job aborted"
        ;;

    *)
        log "Unknown phase: $PHASE"
        ;;
esac

exit 0

# Disaster Recovery Runbook

## Overview

This document outlines procedures for recovering the homelab from various failure scenarios. For detailed backup information, see [backups.md](./backups.md).

## Quick Reference

| Scenario | RTO | RPO | Procedure |
|----------|-----|-----|-----------|
| Single container failure | 15 min | < 24 hrs | [Container Recovery](#single-container-recovery) |
| Proxmox host failure | 2-4 hrs | < 24 hrs | [Full Host Recovery](#full-host-recovery) |
| Database corruption | 30 min | < 24 hrs | [Database Recovery](#database-recovery) |
| Network services down | 5 min | N/A | [Network Recovery](#network-services-recovery) |

## Service Dependencies

### Recovery Order (Critical Path)

Recovery must follow this order due to service dependencies:

```
1. Proxmox VE host
   └── 2. Network Services (LXC 101) - AdGuard DNS
       └── 3. Traefik (LXC 200) - Reverse proxy
           └── 4. Authelia (LXC 202) - SSO/Auth
               └── 5. All other services
```

### Tier 1: Infrastructure (Recover First)

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies | Critical For |
|----|---------|----|--------------|--------------|
| - | Proxmox VE | 192.168.1.215 | None | Everything |
| 101 | Network Services | 10.100.1.101 / 192.168.1.196 | Proxmox | DNS resolution |
| 200 | Traefik | 10.100.2.200 / 192.168.1.235 | DNS | HTTPS access to all services |
| 202 | Authelia | 10.100.2.202 | Traefik | Protected service access |

### Tier 2: Core Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 100 | Portainer | 10.100.1.100 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 500 | Monitoring | 10.100.5.100 | Traefik |
| 201 | Dashboards | 10.100.2.201 | Traefik |

### Tier 3: Application Services

| ID | Service | IP | Dependencies |
|----|---------|----|--------------|
| 304 | Immich | 10.100.3.104 / 192.168.1.222 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 401 | Jellyfin | 10.100.4.101 / 192.168.1.226 | Traefik |
| 402 | Media Management | 10.100.4.102 | Traefik, Authelia, VPN (gluetun) |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 10.100.5.101 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 502 | n8n | 10.100.5.102 | Traefik, Authelia |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | 10.100.5.103 | Traefik |
| 504 | Documents | 10.100.5.104 | Traefik, Authelia |

## Recovery Procedures

### Single Container Recovery

**Time estimate: 15-30 minutes**

1. **Identify the failed container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct list"
   ```

2. **Check available backups**

   ```bash
   task backup:list APP=<app-name>
   # Example: task backup:list APP=immich
   ```

3. **Restore to a new container ID** (safer - allows verification)

   ```bash
   task backup:restore BACKUP=<backup-file> TARGET_ID=<new-id>
   # Example: task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=350
   ```

4. **Verify the restored container**

   ```bash
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"
   # Check services are running
   ssh root@<container-ip> "docker ps"
   ```

5. **Swap containers** (if verification passes)

   ```bash
   # Stop original
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct stop <original-id>"

   # Update network config on new container to use original IP
   # Then start new container
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start <new-id>"

   # If using OpenTofu, update state:
   task tofu:state:rm APP=<app> RESOURCE="module.<app>.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc"
   ```

### Database Recovery

**Time estimate: 30 minutes**

#### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs)

```bash
# 1. List available dumps
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/immich-postgres-*"

# 2. Restore using task
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

#### Jellystat (PostgreSQL)

```bash
# 1. Copy dump to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 401 /tank/backups/database-dumps/jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz /tmp/"

# 2. SSH to Jellyfin container
ssh root@10.100.4.101

# 3. Restore
docker exec -i jellystat-db psql -U jellystat -d jellystat < /tmp/jellystat-postgres-*.sql
```

#### SQLite Databases (OpenWebUI, n8n)

```bash
# Copy from backup dump directory to container
ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct push 501 /tank/backups/database-dumps/openwebui-*.db /config/openwebui/webui.db"

# Restart the service
ssh root@10.100.5.101 "cd /config && docker compose restart"
```

### Network Services Recovery

**Time estimate: 5-10 minutes**

If DNS (AdGuard) is down, LAN devices cannot resolve homelab domains.

1. **Temporary workaround** - Use direct IPs:
   - Proxmox: https://192.168.1.215:8006
   - Traefik: http://192.168.1.235:8080 (dashboard)

2. **Recover AdGuard container**

   ```bash
   # Check container status
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct status 101"

   # Start if stopped
   ssh root@192.168.1.215 "pct start 101"

   # Check AdGuard service
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "docker ps"
   ssh root@10.100.1.101 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
   ```

3. **Verify DNS resolution**

   ```bash
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Full Host Recovery

**Time estimate: 2-4 hours**

This procedure assumes complete Proxmox host failure requiring reinstall.

#### Phase 1: Proxmox Installation (30 min)

1. Boot from Proxmox ISO
2. Install to boot drive
3. Configure network:
   - IP: 192.168.1.215/24
   - Gateway: 192.168.1.1
   - DNS: 1.1.1.1 (temporarily)
4. Import ZFS pool:

   ```bash
   zpool import tank
   ```

#### Phase 2: Restore Configuration (30 min)

1. Clone the homelab repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<user>/homelab.git
   cd homelab
   ```

2. Sync backup configuration:

   ```bash
   task backup:sync
   ```

3. Restore containers from local backups (if ZFS pool survived):

   ```bash
   # List available backups
   ls /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/

   # Restore each container - start with Tier 1
   pct restore 101 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
   pct restore 200 /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst
   # ... continue for all containers
   ```

#### Phase 3: Cloud Recovery (if local backups lost)

If ZFS pool is lost, restore from Backblaze B2:

1. Install rclone and configure with existing credentials:

   ```bash
   apt install rclone
   # Configure b2 and b2-crypt remotes
   ```

2. Download backups:

   ```bash
   rclone copy b2-crypt:vzdump /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/
   rclone copy b2-crypt:database-dumps /tank/backups/database-dumps/
   ```

3. Restore containers as in Phase 2

#### Phase 4: Verification (30 min)

1. Start containers in dependency order:

   ```bash
   pct start 101  # Network Services
   pct start 200  # Traefik
   pct start 202  # Authelia
   # ... rest of containers
   ```

2. Verify services:

   ```bash
   # DNS
   dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev

   # Web services
   curl -k https://homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

3. Re-apply OpenTofu if needed:

   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=traefik
   task tofu:plan APP=traefik
   # Review and apply if needed
   ```

## Verification Checklist

After any recovery, verify:

- [ ] DNS resolution working (`dig @192.168.1.196 homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)
- [ ] Traefik dashboard accessible (https://traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev)
- [ ] Authelia login working
- [ ] Homepage loads and shows service status
- [ ] Immich accessible and photos loading
- [ ] Monitoring (Grafana) showing metrics
- [ ] Backups scheduled (`cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg`)

## Preventive Measures

### Regular Testing

- Monthly: Test restore of one container to verify backups
- Quarterly: Full DR drill - document actual recovery time

### Monitoring Gaps to Address

- [ ] Add backup failure alerting (see proxmox-homelab-v9t)
- [ ] Add Prometheus scrape targets for all services (see proxmox-homelab-30m)

## Contact & Escalation

For issues beyond this runbook:

- Proxmox Forums: https://forum.proxmox.com/
- Backblaze Support: https://www.backblaze.com/help/

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

Based on standard PBS installation patterns, these are the expected configuration locations inside the PBS LXC container:

1. **Datastore Configuration**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/datastore.cfg` - Datastore definitions and storage backends
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/storage.cfg` - Storage configuration (mount points, backends)

2. **User and Authentication**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/user.cfg` - User accounts and credentials
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/tokens.cfg` - API tokens
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/shadow.cfg` - Password hashes

3. **Access Control and Permissions**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/acl.cfg` - Access control lists and role assignments
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/roles.cfg` - Role definitions (Admin, User, etc.)

4. **Retention and Prune Schedules**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/prune.cfg` - Prune job schedules and rules
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/gc.cfg` - Garbage collection schedules
   - Retention policies are typically embedded in backup job configurations

5. **Core Service Configuration**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/proxy.cfg` - API proxy configuration
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/notifications.cfg` - Alert and notification settings
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/systemd/` - Service configurations

6. **Certificates and Security**
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/certificate.pem` - SSL/TLS certificate
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/certificate-key.pem` - Private key
   - `/etc/proxmox-backup/api2-key.pem` - API authentication key

  - Fields: `enabled`, `schedule`, `storage`, `vmid`, `compress`, `prune-backups`
